title: Home Delivery Pharmacy Carrier Zone Table: Alaska and Hawaii Courtesy on Delayed Orders
content:
## Carrier zone table: remote destinations and dispensing delays

**Rule.** On a Home Delivery Pharmacy dispensing-delay credit, a remote-destination courtesy amount is added when the account's shipping ZIP code lies in Alaska (99500 through 99999) or Hawaii (96700 through 96899): 5.00 when the delayed order went out overnight to such a ZIP code, 2.50 when it went out two-day to such a ZIP code, and nothing in every other case.

The ZIP code is the shipping ZIP code on the home delivery account; the service is the shipping method on the delayed order's shipment record. The courtesy amount is added to the credit.

### Courtesy table

| Delayed order went out | Account ZIP within 99500-99999 or 96700-96899 | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| Overnight | Yes | 5.00 |
| Two-day | Yes | 2.50 |
| Overnight or two-day | No | nothing |
| Any other service | either | nothing |

### Boundary ZIP codes (hypothetical accounts, two-day shipment)

| Account ZIP | In range | Courtesy |
|---|---|---|
| 99499 | No | nothing |
| 99500 | Yes | 2.50 |
| 96699 | No | nothing |
| 96700 | Yes | 2.50 |
| 96899 | Yes | 2.50 |
| 96900 | No | nothing |
